`final class SnapshotVulkanHost`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IVulkanHost`](/reference/vulkan/ivulkanhost/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan.snapshot` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [SnapshotVulkanHost.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/snapshot/SnapshotVulkanHost.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

The Vulkan host of the snapshot tests: no surface, one offscreen target image and one frame in flight.

## Description

It ships in the dev and demo jars of the backend.

## Learn more

- [Run inside a Vulkan host](/build/backends/vulkan/#run-inside-a-vulkan-host)

## Creation details

<a id="SnapshotVulkanHost-factory-create"></a>

### create

`SnapshotVulkanHost create(int width, int height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates an instance, a device and a `B8G8R8A8_UNORM` target image of that size in pixels.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when no Vulkan 1.3 device can draw.
